paper_title: Probing the Blue Axion with Cosmic Optical Background Anisotropies
coupling_convention: decay rate Gamma_{a->gamma gamma} in s^-1 (NOT g_agamma). Plotted quantity is the radiative decay rate; lower boundary of HST 606 nm (conservative) excluded region in the CDM panel of Fig. 8
notes: Paper constrains 'blue axion' (m_a ~5-25 eV) via COB anisotropies from HST at 606 nm. Primary results reported as decay rate Gamma_agammagamma (s^-1) / lifetime vs mass, not directly as g_agamma exclusion curves in most figures. Only a few explicit coupling values are given in text: for m_a=4.2 eV, g >~ 2.33e-11 GeV^-1 excluded (note added, MUSE filter gap region). Other text values (e.g. g_agamma <~ 3e-12 GeV^-1 for CDM in 4.5-7.7 eV range) are approximate. Bulk of the exclusion is in the Gamma_a-m_a plane (Figs 1,6,8) which would require Eq.(2) conversion Gamma=g^2 m_a^3/64pi to get g. Because main plots use decay rate not coupling, and multiple couplings (g_agammagamma and g_agammachi) discussed, extraction confidence is moderate.
